stemMd: Why was the second study useful even without certainty?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It tested a documented scenario relevant to the design decision

options.label: B
options.textMd: It showed that existing surroundings never matter

options.label: C
options.textMd: It guaranteed the client’s preferred view

options.label: D
options.textMd: It proved the exact construction date

options.label: E
options.textMd: It removed every uncertainty from the project

explanationMd: A decision can benefit from exploring a credible scenario even when its occurrence or details are uncertain. Permission made the neighbouring development more than an arbitrary speculation, so examining its effects was relevant.

distractorRationale.d: The timing and final scene were not certain.
distractorRationale.b: Both existing and possible future surroundings were studied.
distractorRationale.c: The new scenario could reduce that view.
